nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'Nimbus Wrapped Ether'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'NWETH'.
Public uint8 state variable holding the token decimals (18).
Public mapping(address => uint) storing ETH balances credited to each depositor.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing spending allowances.
Receive fallback function that forwards plain ETH transfers to deposit().
Payable function that credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with msg.value.
Public function that debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and sends ETH to the caller.
View function returning the contract ETH balance as total supply.
Public function that sets allowance[msg.sender][guy] = wad.
Public function that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
Public function that moves balances between accounts and decrements allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, allowance owner/spender and ETH recipient.
External ETH transfer payable(msg.sender).transfer(wad) inside withdraw().
Amount parameter of withdraw() used to debit user balance and to send ETH.
Spender address parameter of approve().
Allowance amount parameter of approve().
Destination address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().

edges.reason: receive() forwards incoming plain ETH to deposit().
deposit() keys the balance update with the untrusted msg.sender.
deposit() writes balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value.
withdraw() uses msg.sender both for the balance check and as the ETH recipient.
withdraw() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] by wad.
The untrusted msg.sender is the recipient of the external ETH transfer.
withdraw() releases control to the caller through an external ETH transfer.
The external call can hand control back to withdraw(), allowing reentrant execution.
approve() writes the allowance keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
approve() updates allowance[msg.sender][guy].
transfer() forwards msg.sender as the src account to transferFrom().
transfer() delegates its logic to transferFrom().
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender when checking allowance.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[src][msg.sender].
transferFrom() subtracts from balanceOf[src] and adds to balanceOf[dst].
The wad parameter drives the balance subtraction and the ETH amount in withdraw().
The wad parameter is the value sent by the external transfer call.
The guy parameter is the spender key written into allowance.
The wad parameter is the allowance value written by approve().
The dst parameter is passed through transfer() into transferFrom().
The wad parameter is passed through transfer() into transferFrom().
The src parameter selects the balance and allowance account in transferFrom().
The dst parameter is credited in balanceOf[dst] by transferFrom().
The wad parameter drives the allowance and balance updates in transferFrom().
The dst parameter of transfer() reaches the dst account of transferFrom().
The wad parameter of transfer() reaches the amount of transferFrom().
